overall: A committee member's letter to a quorum was an unlawful individual deliberation, but the committee as a whole was not found in violation, and no further remedy was ordered because the letter was released at an open meeting.

allegations.summary: A committee member's September 2011 letter to all other members allegedly contained opinions on committee business, violating the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Mr. Zbikowski's September 2, 2011 letter constituted deliberation outside of an open meeting, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Whether the committee as a whole violated the law by way of the member's letter, given the complaint named the committee.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no response from any Committee member, however, we do not find that the Committee as a whole violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Whether the member's violation was intentional, and whether the corrective step of presenting the letter at an open meeting was adequate.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, we do not find that Mr. Zbikowski intentionally violated the law
